subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – pricing plans and thank-you page
body_text:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on the same checkout page, send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, and add GST to your prices. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you added a yearly price to your product, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout page.
- Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the product's After purchase redirect option and saved it, and your test purchase took you straight to your thank-you page.

What we covered:
- We explained that there is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices. This is not yet fully resolved.

Your next steps:
1. Add your privacy policy link to your checkout footer (this week, as you mentioned).

What we'll do next:
- We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.

Our call continued across two recordings, so here are both parts in order:
Part 1: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-1
Part 2: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-2

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
